types.typos: You MUST deliberately misspell one or two words, e.g. the -> teh, with -> wiht, replace -> repalce. Keep all intended visual attributes recoverable. Copying the input unchanged is invalid.
types.informal: Rewrite as a casual search request with informal phrasing or common abbreviations. Preserve every visual constraint.
types.paraphrase: Use natural synonyms and a different sentence structure. Preserve every visual constraint.

conditioning_note: Target-aware modifier construction; not a target-blind benchmark.

parameter_revisions.reason: Expanded the allowable function-word vocabulary after the LLM proposed harmless phrasing such as match/using. Existing accepted perturbations still satisfy the expanded validator; source, model, clean texts and gallery are unchanged.
